feature: Default-off structured ledger verifier for non-aggregate multi-session answers. The ledger reviewer replaces the generic reviewer on scoped rows, validates user-authored citations and selected fact IDs, and fails open to the pre-review answer.
adapter_commit: d1b2d70 feat: add opt-in cross-session fact ledger verifier
design_commit: 1eb4739 docs: plan cross-session fact ledger verifier
retrieval_source: Stage300 saved Top-200 candidate sets and the exact recorded selected Top-20 order; no reranker call in the pilot.
decision: Keep the verifier opt-in. The six-row pilot includes one correction caused by the ledger and one pass from fresh answer generation when the ledger abstained. On the complete 22-row eligible cohort, the full candidate tied Stage300 at 16/22; paired outcomes were three wins and three losses. Two ledger revisions changed Stage300 failures to PASS, and no ledger revision turned a Stage300 PASS into FAIL. The run-level tie reflects answer-generation variation and does not establish a net full-score improvement.
limitations: This is a 22-row pilot, not the release score. Stage166 stochastic token reservation was not exercised. Memory precision and live offsite restore remain unmeasured/unverified.
